Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
8:01 PM

The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi, is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays, so it is closed now and next opens Sat 24 Oct, 10:00 AM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card. Tickets can be booked at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. This is from the museum's own site, which doesn't show when it was last updated.
